expect_red: one selection across the seam: the pane's tree says it holds the node's end row, a tree that has not caught up says nothing, and a pane that let go lets the page go

mutations.contract: A pane that let go of the row it held lets go of the page's selection, rather than being re-asserted.
mutations.note: Declared with the guard by handoff the_pane_follows_the_one_selection_both_ways (2026-11-12). Without the let-go branch the pane's deselect is swallowed.
mutations.find: if (endRows.length && held === nodeId) return { letGo: true, held: null };
mutations.replace: if (endRows.length && held === nodeId) return { letGo: false, held: null };

mutations.contract: Only a pane SEEN holding the row can let go of it: a tree that has not caught up is not a deselect.
mutations.note: Without the held test the first tree after the page's post -- which shows nothing selected yet -- lets go of the selection the reader just made.
mutations.find: if (endRows.length && held === nodeId) return { letGo: true, held: null };
mutations.replace: if (endRows.length) return { letGo: true, held: null };
